title: Unipolar Concept Activation & Neutral Hold
intuition: Activates a single positive concept direction (cover >= 0.85) while simultaneously holding neutral samples stationary (neu_hold >= 0.85) and preventing off-caption leakage (off_caption <= 0.05).
failure_mode: Unanchored critic logits or aggressive generator steps push neutral points along the active pole, violating neu_hold or causing off-caption contamination.
protocol_notes: 400-step locked-shared behavioral host with 24 evenly spaced sustained evaluations.
